quality_rules.answer_positions: Correct positions are deterministically balanced; the site may reshuffle again between attempts.
quality_rules.distractors: Concept-linked misconceptions only; clearly irrelevant distractors are excluded.
quality_rules.language: Short, conversational and suitable for teacher or system read-aloud.
quality_rules.visuals: Structured SVG metadata with descriptive alt text and a text fallback.
quality_rules.feedback: Every item has a child-friendly summary and an actionable hint.
quality_rules.audio: audio_prompt stores read-aloud text for system text-to-speech; no MP3 asset is required.
